parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: How `source` is interpreted: `module` (a fully-qualified MDL material name, or a `.mdle` path), `mdle` (a path to a `.mdle` file), or `code` (inline MDL module source)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The MDL content, interpreted per `sourceType`: a module/material name, a `.mdle` path, or inline MDL module source

parameters.name: materialName
parameters.description: Optional. Selects the material within `source`. For `module`, when set, `source` is treated as a pure module name (no `::material` split); for `mdle` it must be `main`; for `code` it defaults to `main`
